desc:
An illustrative and meditative oil pastel workshop for women to connect and explore colour through emotion and self-expression, learning techniques in colour theory, abstracted landscapes, layering, texture, and intuitive mark-making.

Guided by Professional Artist Nora Alkeyat. Templates and materials provided. 
18+ | Sisters only 
Thursday Sept 3 | 6pm - 8:30pm 
Studio.89 Café, Mississauga
location: 2520 Eglinton Ave W Unit 1, Mississauga, ON L5M 0Y4, Canada
title: Oil Pastel Art Therapy
